_comment: Clips Raven wants left exactly as they are. A monster clip that plays wrong is NOT
automatically a defect: some are keepers for their comedic value (Raven, 2026-09-04:
'there are some animations that are super buggy potentially, but I want to keep some in
their current state since they have a ton of comedic value').
Before any change that could alter clips broadly -- the pose driver, the motion build, the
keyframe reducer's tolerances, the borrowed-list retargeting -- check what it does to these
and say so. Reference frames of each are in dev/shots/keeper-<slug>/.
This is not a list of everything janky. It is the list Raven has explicitly claimed.
